text:
Alex: Quick midday poll — Burrito Roulette at noon? Rules: blind pick from the fridge, no take-backs. :burrito:
Maria: I'm in. Will bring electrolytes. :sweat_smile:
Devon: only if someone codes a spinner. :space_invader:
Sara: +1 (but I label mine 'veggie victory' so it counts) :v:
Kofi: I'm allergic to cilantro so voting no but will supervise. :detective:
Alex: Haha fair — label swap allowed. Also quick one-liner contest while we eat? Winner gets first burrito pick. 1 line, 1 meter of pride.
Maria: "Bought my plant a tiny hat." :hat_with_wide_brim: — instant classic.
Devon: "Microwave sings better than me." :microphone: :musical_note:
Sara: "Left my hoodie again; it's plotting." :hoodie:
Alex: LOL. Also, FYI fridge mystery burrito is in Tupperware labeled '???' — whoever claims it has to defend the taste.
ops-bot: Reminder: Quiet workspace after 1pm for interview panel.
Kofi: Noted. We'll keep cheers to under 60 dB. :ear:
Maria: Can someone take a pic of the burrito evidence for the 'who stole my lunch' channel? :camera_with_flash:
Devon: I'll take it but only after I finish my debugging sprint. ETA 12:05.
Sara: small oohs and ahhs during unwrapping permitted. :eyes:
Alex: Poll: who wants to play? React with :thumbsup: to join. I'll tally at 11:45.
Maria: :thumbsup:
Devon: :thumbsup: :thumbsup:
Sara: :thumbsup:
Kofi: :thumbsup:
Alex: Sweet. Winner of one-liner gets bragging rights and a snack coupon. See y'all at noon.
Maria: :trophy: Good luck to all hats and hoodies.
